name: pioneer
why: An open-source lonely space trading and exploration sim with real depth, the kind of game you lose a weekend to.

brief.what_it_is: Pioneer is a free, open-source space adventure game set in the Milky Way at the turn of a future century. The player explores millions of star systems, lands on planets, and makes a living by trading between systems, piracy, smuggling, bounty hunting, or missions for factions. The homepage describes an open-ended sandbox where the player decides what kind of spacefaring life to lead. The brew package installs four executables: pioneer (the game), editor, modelcompiler, and savegamedump. The README does not describe what the three tools do beyond their names.
brief.why_it_exists: The author frames it as an open-ended game where 'the universe is whatever you make of it', with a community of players, modders and developers who can make part of the galaxy their own. The homepage says it is 'under constant development'.
brief.install_notes: Beyond brew install, the README points to a prebuilt download at https://pioneerspacesim.net/page/download/ and to COMPILING.txt in the repo for building from source. I did not open COMPILING.txt, so build requirements are unverified. The README mentions a wiki manual and basic flight and keyboard/mouse control pages, which I did not fetch.
brief.standout: The README has an explicit AI policy: it refuses code contributions that are wholly or largely AI-generated, citing GPLv3 licensing, and allows only AI autocomplete as an assistive tool. Translations are handled through Transifex, so contributors are told not to send translation pull requests.
brief.status: Maintained, with weak evidence. The homepage says 'under constant development', the copyright runs 2008-2026, and the repo shows a Build workflow badge. I did not see a release date or last-commit date, so the current release cadence is unknown.
brief.caveats: The homepage and README disagree on the setting: the homepage says the 33rd century and the README says the 31st. The README also says the game is set 'in the Milky Way galaxy' while the homepage says 'our galaxy'. Licence is GPLv3 according to the README badge. The scout note's claim of 'real depth' is not something I could verify from these pages.
quotes: The universe is whatever you make of it.
Pioneer is under constant development and has a friendly community of players, modders and developers around it.
Pioneer does not accept AI-generated code contributions.

judge.reason: An obscure space sim turns a vast Milky Way into a hands-on sandbox for planetary landings, trading, piracy, and exploration—not merely a pretty interface.

entry.title: Pioneer
entry.tldr: A free, open-source space sandbox where you fly between star systems, land on planets, and make a living by trading, smuggling, piracy, or bounty hunting.
entry.deeper_look:
Pioneer is a space adventure game set in the Milky Way at the turn of a future century. You explore star systems, land on planets, and decide how to earn a living: trading between systems, piracy, smuggling, bounty hunting, or missions for factions. The homepage says there are millions of star systems to visit.

The author's framing is an open-ended sandbox: "The universe is whatever you make of it." There is no single story to follow. The game is a loop of flying, docking, and choosing what kind of spacefaring life to lead.

The Homebrew package installs four executables. `pioneer` is the game. The other three, `editor`, `modelcompiler` and `savegamedump`, are named in the package but not described in the README. Going by their names, they look like tools for working with models and save files, which would fit the project's modding community. That is a guess from the names.

The project says it is "under constant development" and has "a friendly community of players, modders and developers around it." It is GPLv3, and the README is unusually explicit that it does not accept AI-generated code contributions, citing licensing.
entry.install:
brew install pioneer
# This is a graphical game with a window, not a terminal program. Prebuilt downloads are at https://pioneerspacesim.net/page/download/ and COMPILING.txt in the repo covers building from source.

try_this.what_happens: Launches the game in a graphical window so you can start a new game and pick a starting system.
Prints the command line options the game accepts.

entry.whats_unique: It is a long-running, community-built open-source space sim with no scripted story, and its repo has a stated policy against AI-generated code contributions.
entry.caveats: The brief found only weak evidence of recent activity (no release or commit dates), and the homepage and README disagree on the century of the setting.
